candidates.title: Evaluation of the Lawson criterion for aneutronic proton-boron-11 fusion: effects of ion temperature and bremsstrahlung losses
candidates.notes: 2026 Frontiers article, fully open access (CC BY). Directly evaluates the Lawson criterion for p-B11 including bremsstrahlung losses. Key finding: Ti >= 125-190 keV required when Te < Ti, with minimum Lawson values of 1.3e22 to 1.2e23 m^-3 s depending on radiation assumptions. References Nevins and Swain (2000) extensively. More comprehensive and recent than the original Rider/Nevins papers. Extracted successfully.

candidates.title: A study of the requirements of p-11B fusion reactor by tokamak system code
candidates.notes: arxiv preprint using tokamak system code for p-11B. Finds Q>1 is achievable thermally if synchrotron radiation is neglected, but synchrotron radiation substantially reduces performance. Also addresses helium ash management. Highly relevant for multiple gaps but not extracted due to budget — recommend for next iteration.

candidates.title: Assessing Proton-Boron Fusion Feasibility under non-Thermal Equilibrium Conditions: Rider's Inhibition Revisited
candidates.notes: 2024 arxiv paper directly revisiting Rider's constraints for non-equilibrium conditions. Not extracted due to budget — recommend for next iteration alongside the tokamak system code paper.
